description: AlphaFold model geometry for acn1 candidate catalytic residues plus a motif comparison figure
code:
import requests, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

r=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/O74380",timeout=90)
meta=r.json()[0]
print("AF entry:", meta.get("entryId"), "model v", meta.get("latestVersion"))
pdb=requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
atoms=[]
for l in pdb.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        atoms.append((l[12:16].strip(), l[17:20].strip(), int(l[22:26]),
                      float(l[30:38]), float(l[38:46]), float(l[46:54]), float(l[60:66])))
import collections
plddt={a[2]:a[6] for a in atoms if a[0]=="CA"}
resname={a[2]:a[1] for a in atoms}
print("n residues:", len(plddt), " mean pLDDT %.1f"%np.mean(list(plddt.values())))
dom=[v for k,v in plddt.items() if 228<=k<=304]
print("mean pLDDT in PF13813 domain 228-304: %.1f"%np.mean(dom))
for rn in [245,249,250,262,263,280,283,287,288,292]:
    print(f"  {resname.get(rn)}{rn} pLDDT {plddt.get(rn):.1f}")

def sc(num):
    A=[(x,y,z) for n,rn,num2,x,y,z,b in atoms if num2==num and n not in ("N","C","O")]
    return np.array(A)
def md(a,b):
    A,B=sc(a),sc(b); return np.sqrt(((A[:,None]-B[None])**2).sum(-1)).min()
print("\nSide-chain min distances (A) in the AlphaFold model:")
for p in [(287,250),(287,263),(287,292),(250,263),(287,245),(287,249),(250,249)]:
    print(f"  {resname[p[0]]}{p[0]} - {resname[p[1]]}{p[1]}: {md(*p):.2f}")

A=sc(287); near={}
for n,rn,num,x,y,z,b in atoms:
    if num==287: continue
    d=np.sqrt(((A-np.array([x,y,z]))**2).sum(-1)).min()
    if d<7.0: near[num]=min(near.get(num,99),d)
print("\nResidues within 7 A of H287 side chain:",
      ", ".join(f"{resname[n]}{n}({d:.1f})" for n,d in sorted(near.items())))

# Figure
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(11,6.4),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1,1.25]})
ax=axes[0]
xs=sorted(plddt); ax.plot(xs,[plddt[i] for i in xs],color="#3B5BDB",lw=1.3)
ax.axvspan(228,304,color="#FFD43B",alpha=0.3,label="PF13813 wax synthase domain (228-304)")
for rn,lab,col in [(250,"H250","#E8590C"),(287,"H287","#C92A2A")]:
    ax.axvline(rn,color=col,ls="--",lw=1.2); ax.text(rn,103,lab,color=col,ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("acn1 (O74380) residue"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(0,112)
ax.set_title("A. AlphaFold confidence for acn1 and position of the conserved His residues",loc="left",fontsize=11)
ax.legend(loc="lower left",fontsize=8)

ax=axes[1]; ax.axis("off")
rows=[
 ("acn1 (S. pombe, O74380)",      "F244-W245-S-R-D-W249-H250", "S283-A-L-F-H287-D288-F"),
 ("pyr8 (A. fumigatus, PF13813)", "F262-W-G-K-F-W266-H267",    "S307-A-V-L-H311-L-A"),
 ("ASAT1 (A. thaliana, PF13813)", "F197-W-G-R-R-W201-N202",    "S241-G-I-M-H245-E-L"),
 ("DGAT1 (human, PF03062)",       "F373-W374-Q-N-W377-N378",   "S410-A-F-F-H415-E416-Y"),
 ("SOAT1 (human, PF03062)",       "T419-W420-N421",            "S455-A-V-V-H460-E461-Y"),
 ("HHAT (human, PF03062)",        "L336-H-N338-D339",          "S376-Y-W-H379-G-G-Y"),
]
ax.text(0.01,0.95,"B. Conserved motifs around the MBOAT catalytic His and the upstream Asn/His position",
        fontsize=11,transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(0.02,0.84,"protein",fontsize=9,weight="bold",transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(0.34,0.84,"upstream Asn/His position",fontsize=9,weight="bold",transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(0.68,0.84,"catalytic His motif",fontsize=9,weight="bold",transform=ax.transAxes)
for i,(a,b,c) in enumerate(rows):
    y=0.74-i*0.115
    ax.text(0.02,y,a,fontsize=9,transform=ax.transAxes,family="monospace")
    ax.text(0.34,y,b,fontsize=9,transform=ax.transAxes,family="monospace",
            color="#E8590C" if i<3 else "#1864AB")
    ax.text(0.68,y,c,fontsize=9,transform=ax.transAxes,family="monospace",
            color="#C92A2A" if i<3 else "#1864AB")
ax.text(0.02,0.03,"Pfam seed columns: PF13813 col121 (His, 70/70 sequences) aligns to PF03062 col373 (His, 20/20), the\n"
                  "experimentally validated catalytic His of DGAT1 (H415), SOAT1 (H460) and HHAT (H379).",
        fontsize=8.5,transform=ax.transAxes,color="#495057")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
